name: EPIC 201447159
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 9.5 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201447159 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.456573 (16th-84th percentiles 9.047431-9.888913), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201447159 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.928012 (16th-84th percentiles 0.832955-1.03417), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201447159: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4822.2725 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201447159 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4171.25 (16th-84th percentiles 4028.789062-4317.5), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.03 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,171 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.93 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,822 K at its surface.
